text:
ana: Quick sync — need an updated battlecard for next week's product launch. Focus: positioning vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Three must-haves: clear differentiator (cost/latency), benchmark narrative w/ provenance, and inbound routing cues for SDRs. Who can own?
devon: I can own the battlecard layout. Need raw numbers from eng for QPS/latency/cost. Also want 2x rebut lines for procurement/security.
mike: I'll own inbound routing + SDR scripts. Can we get a hero benchmark: '2x lower per-token cost at 95th pct latency'? Need exact numbers.
sarah: I'll pull bench data. Quick ask: which models and payloads? We used 16k context chat and embedding pipelines last time. Suggest focusing on typical PLG flows: chat + embeddings for vector search.
olga: Draft soundbites: - "Production-first inference: predictable cost, deterministic latency." - "Unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private — same API, fewer surprises." I'll paste some quick one-liners below.
olga: ```
Hero line: "Get predictable, production-grade LLM inference — fastest time-to-value with enterprise-grade controls."
Rebut: Cloud AI: "Which SLA? We provide committed latency tiers + fallback routing."
Infra vendor: "We manage the serving runtime so you don't need to operate kernels, routing, cache."
```
devon: Add a short section on fallbacks/canary + rollback: "Automatic model variant fallback to maintain SLAs" — important vs cloud that just returns 503s.
mike: For inbound routing: suggested lead routing tags: - score >= $X usage -> AE - security flag -> SE + enterprise track - benchmark request -> Solutions eng
mike: Also add a simple SDR opener: "We can show a 15–30 minute perf review with your infra team — do you have 30 min next week?"
sarah: Bench numbers (prelim) from eng-sre: - 95th latency (chat, 4k input) = 110ms on p4d equivalent - per-token cost (hosted optimized) = $0.0009/token - Our optimized batch + kv cache shows ~35% cost saving vs baseline I'll link the perf doc: https://redwoodhq.notion/perf/launch-bench
devon: Great. Can we make the claim "35% savings vs stock serverless LLM endpoints" but mark provenance "internal bench, 4k chat, mixed batch"? Need legal review for public.
nana (ana correction): (typo earlier) — legal flagged. 
nana: (ignore this line)
nana: (oops)
nana: (reposting)
nana: Yes flag for legal. Also we need a quick webinar narrative that ties benchmark to customer ROI. Who can draft a 1-slide storyline?
olga: I can do the slide draft. Outline: - Problem: unpredictable cost & latency with managed endpoints - Approach: unified runtime + smart routing + cache - Proof: 35% cost, 110ms p95 - CTA: live perf review + dedicated trial
eng-bot: Deploy note: bench data sourced from perf/bench-2026-03-15 run-7. Artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/launch-2026-03-15.tar.gz
mike: Awesome. Action items: - devon: update battlecard + 2 rebut lines (due Tue EOD) - sarah: confirm bench numbers and attach artifacts (due Mon noon) - olga: slide + one-pager (due Wed) - me: SDR scripts + routing rules (due Wed)
nana: Sounds good. Quick ask: prioritize messaging vs "LLM APIs" — customers care about open model catalog + quantization recommendations. Add that to features list.
devon: Will do. One more: include "graceful degradation" playbook vs capacity issues.
sarah: I'll also add sample graphs (latency distribution & cost per-token) to the battlecard.
nana: Perfect. Ping me when first draft is ready. :thumbsup:
mike: Pinged the SDR channel and pipeline owner. :rocket:
